_comment: GOLDEN-63, 1 h, DUAL-FREQUENCY arm — the 'fast version' (_golden63_gps_1h_laneoff.json,
lane_carry OFF) with the ONLY change being processing.frequency_mode triple -> dual.
Everything else is inherited verbatim: 61 in-network stations, WTZZ00DEU colocated
consumer holdout, GPS-only, channel_mode single, lane_carry OFF, the full golden
instrumentation tier, and the parallel posture (pcarry on / preduce off).
PURPOSE: measure how much faster the producer runs on two bands instead of three.
The a-priori expectation is that the saving is NOT proportional to band count — the
63-sta epoch measured 2266.8 ms median settled with lane OFF, attributed as
install-post 706.9 / solve-glue 363.6 / assembly 250.6 / dd-build 173.3 /
cov-consumers 163.6 / reduce 134.2.  The band-scaling terms are the ambiguity-carrying
ones (dd-build, install-post, solve-glue via K_c); assembly, cov-consumers and reduce
scale with STATIONS and shared dimension, not bands, so they should be roughly flat.
Grade the delta on the D0/D0b section medians over settled epochs, not on wall.
BAND SCOPE: FrequencyMode::Dual = two bands per constellation = GPS L1+L2
(GnssConfigTypes.hpp:1914).  Triple would add L5.  Note not every GPS satellite on
DOY-129 broadcasts L5 (Block IIF/III only), so the realised state-vector reduction is
smaller than a flat 1/3 — read the actual carried-DD and K_c counters, not the ratio.
⚠️ KNOWN SIDE EFFECT, not a misconfiguration: the WL-2 EWL statistic tier is defined on
GPS (L2,L5) and the UWL-1 top tier likewise needs the third band.  With dual there is no
L5, so those tiers go INERT.  The loader does NOT fail-loud on this — it is an advisory
log->info ('Requires frequency_mode with the 3rd band (GPS L5 / Galileo E5b)',
GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:5532), so mw_wl.ewl_enable will still read ARMED in the log
while producing no EWL rows.  That is inherent to dual-frequency, not a defect, but it
means this arm is NOT a clean single-variable A/B against the triple arm: it changes
both the band scope AND the (already lane-OFF) EWL statistic availability.  Read the
run-end MW/WL counters to confirm the tier is reporting zero rows rather than silently
contributing.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY: frequency_mode changes the state vector, so this must converge
fresh.  Its output paths are its own — never resume it onto the triple arm's snapshot.
SCOPE: like its parent, 1 h grades wiring + cost.  It cannot grade total_IF.
